privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro01: Welcome to our Medical Dental Education Platform ("Platform", "we", "us", or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our educational testing and quiz application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This policy applies to all users of our Platform, including medical and dental students, residents, practitioners, and educators.

blocks.heading: Personal Information
items: Name, email address, and phone number
Educational institution and program information
Professional credentials and certifications
Profile picture and bio (optional)

blocks.heading: Usage Data
items: Test scores, quiz results, and performance analytics
Study patterns, time spent on questions, and progress tracking
Device information, IP address, and browser type
Login times and activity logs

blocks.heading: Communication Data
items: Direct messages with other users (instructors, peers)
Forum posts, comments, and discussions
Customer support inquiries and feedback

blocks.heading: Your Privacy Rights
items: Access: Request access to your personal data and obtain a copy
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal requirements
Data Portability: Request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Opt-Out: Opt out of marketing communications at any time

blocks.heading: Third-Party Services
items: Our Platform may contain links to third-party websites or integrate with third-party services.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external services.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: The information provided on this platform is for educational purposes only and should not be considered professional medical or dental advice.

blocks.heading: No Professional Advice
items: Content is intended for educational and exam preparation purposes only
Not a substitute for professional medical or dental consultation

blocks.heading: Accuracy of Information
items: We strive to keep content accurate and up to date
We do not guarantee completeness or accuracy at all times

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By accessing or using our Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.

blocks.heading: User Responsibilities
items: Provide accurate and complete registration information
Maintain the confidentiality of your account credentials
Use the platform in compliance with applicable laws

blocks.heading: Prohibited Activities
items: Unauthorized access to systems or data
Copying or redistributing content without permission
Engaging in harmful or abusive behavior
